verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM explicitly supports uploading documents into a private knowledge base for RAG-grounded chat (anythingllm-docs-2, anythingllm-gh-1, anythingllm-docs-17), and this is corroborated by hands-on community use testing it against regulatory PDFs with mostly correct grounded answers (anythingllm-comm-6, anythingllm-comm-1/3). Missing for 10: independent verification of citation accuracy at scale (one reviewer found citation snippets 'a bit garbled') and no first-party benchmark on large/complex document sets.
